# 3. Did EBP/CDEP services impact clinical and functional outcomes for clients who participated?

## 3.01 Are there factors such as race, ethnicity, age, gender identity, sexual orientation, language barriers, etc. that are associated with differences in clinical and functional outcomes after the intervention?

**Inclusion criteria:** 1. must have initial time point data (i.e., be enrolled in an intervention), 2. must have a valid assessment collected at both intake and discharge time points, and 3. must be attached to a grantee location. Clients with a characteristic not reported stay in that comparison as a "Not reported" group.

**Outcome:** `positive_outcomes` from the cleaned demographic and discharge file (an improved score from the initial to the follow-up assessment).

**Calculation:** For each characteristic, the number and percentage of episodes with a positive outcome in each group, a chi-square test, and unadjusted odds ratios from a logistic regression of the outcome on that characteristic alone.

**Assumptions:** The unit is the episode of care, not the client, so a client with more than one episode is counted once per episode and the tests treat episodes as independent. Race and ethnicity come from the codes assigned in `report_data_cleaning.qmd` (`code_num`, `ethn_num`). Groups with fewer than the suppression threshold of episodes are combined into "Other (combined)". "Preferred language met" is the `lang` answer on each client's most recent satisfaction survey.

**Still to do:** intervention type and care setting from the grantee file are not yet in the comparison.

```{r}
#| label: helpers
# Formatting, cleaning, suppression, and table helpers are copied verbatim from the 1.01 script; keep them in sync.
fmt_n <- function(n) formatC(as.numeric(n), format = "f", digits = 0, big.mark = ",")
fmt_n_qa <- function(n) {
  ifelse(SHAREABLE & !is.na(n) & n > 0 & n < SUPPRESS_N, paste0("<", SUPPRESS_N), fmt_n(n))
}
fmt_pct <- function(p, digits = 1) {
  ifelse(is.na(p) | is.nan(p), "", sprintf(paste0("%.", digits, "f%%"), 100 * p))
}

# Squish, send non-substantive responses and blanks to NA, and optionally collapse everything
# outside `keep` into `other`. Missing values stay missing (they are not collapsed into `other`).
clean_category <- function(x, non_response = NR_BASE, keep = NULL, other = NULL) {
  x <- str_squish(as.character(x))
  x <- if_else(x %in% non_response | x == "", NA_character_, x)
  if (!is.null(keep)) x <- if_else(is.na(x) | x %in% keep, x, other)
  x
}

code_to_label <- function(code, labels) {
  code_chr <- str_squish(as.character(code))
  case_when(
    is.na(code_chr) | code_chr == "" ~ NA_character_,
    code_chr %in% names(labels)      ~ unname(labels[code_chr]),
    TRUE                             ~ paste0("Code ", code_chr, " (not in codebook)")
  )
}

# ---- Primary and complementary suppression ----
# `x` holds every published or derivable number in a table (cells and totals). Each element of `lines`
# indexes entries tied by one additive constraint, with the total LAST (a row's cells, then its total).
# Counts of 1 to k - 1 are suppressed, then more entries are suppressed until:
#   (a) no line has exactly one suppressed entry, which subtraction would recover;
#   (b) in a line whose total is shown, the suppressed cells add up to at least k, so their combined
#       count (total minus the shown cells) is not itself a small count; and
#   (c) no suppressed count below k, and no sum of two suppressed counts that is below k, can be
#       solved for exactly from all of the table's constraints taken together (checked by matrix rank).
# Extra suppressions go to the entry with the lowest `weight` (by default, the smallest count).
# An entry with weight Inf is never chosen, e.g. because another table already shows it. An entry
# that can be read off a line whose other entries are all zero or shown elsewhere cannot be
# protected, so it is never chosen either. If no entry can protect a hidden count, the render stops
# rather than publish a count that could be recovered.
pick_entry <- function(cand, weight) {
  cand <- cand[is.finite(weight[cand])]
  if (length(cand) == 0L) NA_integer_ else cand[which.min(weight[cand])]
}

recoverable_entries <- function(x, lines, s, k) {
  sup <- which(s)
  if (length(sup) == 0L) return(integer())
  A <- do.call(rbind, lapply(lines, function(ln) {
    row <- numeric(length(x))
    row[ln] <- c(rep(1, length(ln) - 1L), -1)
    row[sup]
  }))
  A <- A[rowSums(A != 0) > 0, , drop = FALSE]
  if (nrow(A) == 0L) return(integer())
  r <- qr(A)$rank
  solvable <- function(v) qr(rbind(A, v))$rank == r
  unit <- function(j) as.numeric(seq_along(sup) == j)
  small <- which(x[sup] < k)
  hits <- sup[small[vapply(small, function(j) solvable(unit(j)), logical(1))]]
  if (length(hits) == 0L && length(small) > 1L) {
    for (pr in combn(small, 2, simplify = FALSE)) {
      if (sum(x[sup[pr]]) < k && solvable(unit(pr[1]) + unit(pr[2]))) {
        hits <- sup[pr]
        break
      }
    }
  }
  hits
}

suppress_lines <- function(x, lines, k = SUPPRESS_N, init = NULL, weight = x) {
  s <- !is.na(x) & x > 0 & x < k
  if (!is.null(init)) s <- s | init
  repeat {
    pinned <- unlist(lapply(lines, function(ln) {
      unknown <- ln[x[ln] > 0 & (is.finite(weight[ln]) | s[ln])]
      if (length(unknown) == 1L && is.finite(weight[unknown])) unknown
    }))
    if (length(pinned) == 0L) break
    weight[pinned] <- Inf
  }
  open_entries <- function(idx) idx[!s[idx] & x[idx] > 0]
  cannot_protect <- function() {
    stop("Complementary suppression cannot protect a hidden count: every entry that could be ",
         "hidden with it is zero or shown in another table.", call. = FALSE)
  }
  repeat {
    j <- NA_integer_
    for (ln in lines) {
      tot <- ln[length(ln)]
      cells <- ln[-length(ln)]
      small_sum <- !s[tot] && any(s[cells]) && sum(x[cells][s[cells]]) < k
      if (sum(s[ln]) == 1L || small_sum) {
        j <- pick_entry(open_entries(ln), weight)
        if (is.na(j)) cannot_protect()
        break
      }
    }
    if (is.na(j)) {
      rec <- recoverable_entries(x, lines, s, k)
      if (length(rec) > 0L) {
        near <- unique(unlist(lines[vapply(lines, function(ln) any(rec %in% ln), logical(1))]))
        j <- pick_entry(open_entries(near), weight)
        if (is.na(j)) j <- pick_entry(open_entries(seq_along(x)), weight)
        if (is.na(j)) cannot_protect()
      }
    }
    if (is.na(j)) break
    s[j] <- TRUE
  }
  s
}

# Suppression pattern for a matrix of counts with its totals attached: row totals in the last column
# and column totals in the last row. Every row and column is a line. Extra suppressions go to inner
# cells first, then to row totals, and to the grand total last, because hiding the grand total forces
# a column total to be hidden too. `init` marks entries that start hidden and `fixed` marks entries
# that are never hidden, usually because another table hides or shows the same number.
suppress_table <- function(ext, init = FALSE, fixed = FALSE) {
  R <- nrow(ext) - 1L
  C <- ncol(ext) - 1L
  idx <- matrix(seq_along(ext), nrow(ext))
  lines <- c(lapply(seq_len(R + 1L), function(i) idx[i, ]),
             lapply(seq_len(C + 1L), function(j) idx[, j]))
  weight <- as.vector(ext)
  weight[idx[seq_len(R), C + 1L]] <- weight[idx[seq_len(R), C + 1L]] + 1e9
  weight[idx[R + 1L, C + 1L]] <- weight[idx[R + 1L, C + 1L]] + 2e9
  weight[rep_len(as.vector(fixed), length(ext))] <- Inf
  s <- suppress_lines(as.vector(ext), lines, init = rep_len(as.vector(init), length(ext)), weight = weight)
  matrix(s, nrow(ext))
}

# One-way frequency table in the interim report's layout: N, % of all, and % excluding N/As.
# `not_reported` lists labels (besides NA) that count as non-substantive. The result carries the
# categories it shows and hides, so a cross-tab of the same variable can match them (see `like`).
tab_one_way <- function(x, label = "Category", order = character(), not_reported = character(),
                        show_valid = TRUE, digits = 1) {
  if (length(x) == 0L) return(tibble(!!label := "No records"))
  x <- if_else(is.na(x), NOT_REPORTED, as.character(x))
  nr_labels <- c(not_reported, NOT_REPORTED)
  counts <- count(tibble(category = x), category)
  present <- counts$category
  lv <- c(intersect(setdiff(order, nr_labels), present),
          sort(setdiff(present, c(order, nr_labels))),
          intersect(nr_labels, present))
  counts <- counts[match(lv, counts$category), ]

  n <- counts$n
  is_sub <- !(counts$category %in% nr_labels)
  m <- length(n)
  i_sub <- m + 1L; i_nr <- m + 2L; i_tot <- m + 3L
  x_all <- c(n, sum(n[is_sub]), sum(n[!is_sub]), sum(n))
  lines <- list(c(which(is_sub), i_sub), c(which(!is_sub), i_nr), c(i_sub, i_nr, i_tot))
  s <- if (SHAREABLE) suppress_lines(x_all, lines) else rep(FALSE, length(x_all))
  sc <- s[seq_len(m)]

  body <- tibble(
    category = counts$category,
    N = if_else(sc, SUPPR, fmt_n(n)),
    `%` = if_else(sc | s[i_tot], SUPPR, fmt_pct(n / x_all[i_tot], digits)),
    `% (excluding N/As)` = case_when(
      !is_sub         ~ "N/A",
      sc | s[i_sub]   ~ SUPPR,
      TRUE            ~ fmt_pct(n / x_all[i_sub], digits)
    )
  )
  subtotal <- tibble(
    category = "Subtotal: substantive responses",
    N = if_else(s[i_sub], SUPPR, fmt_n(x_all[i_sub])),
    `%` = if_else(s[i_sub] | s[i_tot], SUPPR, fmt_pct(x_all[i_sub] / x_all[i_tot], digits)),
    `% (excluding N/As)` = if_else(s[i_sub], SUPPR, "100.0%")
  )
  total <- tibble(category = "Total", N = if_else(s[i_tot], SUPPR, fmt_n(x_all[i_tot])),
                  `%` = if_else(s[i_tot], SUPPR, "100.0%"), `% (excluding N/As)` = "")

  out <- if (show_valid) {
    bind_rows(body[is_sub, ], subtotal, body[!is_sub, ], total)
  } else {
    bind_rows(body, total) |> select(-`% (excluding N/As)`)
  }
  out <- rename(out, !!label := category)
  attr(out, "hidden") <- counts$category[sc]
  attr(out, "shown")  <- counts$category[!sc]
  # A cross-tab of this variable leaves out missing values, so its grand total can be read from this
  # table only when no total and no non-substantive count here is hidden.
  attr(out, "total_hidden") <- any(s[c(which(!is_sub), i_sub, i_nr, i_tot)])
  out
}

# Two-way table with row percentages and counts, e.g. "45% (1,234)", plus a Total row and an N column.
# Every row and column (including the Total row and N column) is a suppression line (see
# `suppress_table()`). A row whose total is hidden shows counts without percentages, because its
# percentages would reveal that total. Rows follow factor level order when `rows` is a factor.
# `like`: an earlier table of the same column variable over the same clients (one-way or two-way).
# Its hidden categories and grand total start hidden in this table's Total row, and the ones it shows
# are never hidden here, so the two tables cannot be combined to recover a suppressed count.
tab_two_way <- function(rows, cols, row_label = "Group", col_order = character(), digits = 0,
                        like = NULL) {
  if (length(rows) == 0L) return(tibble(!!row_label := "No records"))
  row_lv <- as.character(sort(unique(rows[!is.na(rows)])))
  rows <- if_else(is.na(rows), NOT_REPORTED, as.character(rows))
  cols <- if_else(is.na(cols), NOT_REPORTED, as.character(cols))
  if (any(rows == NOT_REPORTED)) row_lv <- c(row_lv, NOT_REPORTED)
  present <- unique(cols)
  col_lv <- c(intersect(setdiff(col_order, NOT_REPORTED), present),
              sort(setdiff(present, c(col_order, NOT_REPORTED))),
              intersect(NOT_REPORTED, present))

  m <- unclass(table(factor(rows, row_lv), factor(cols, col_lv)))
  R <- nrow(m); C <- ncol(m)
  ext <- rbind(cbind(m, rowSums(m)), c(colSums(m), sum(m)))

  s_mat <- matrix(FALSE, R + 1, C + 1)
  if (SHAREABLE) {
    init <- fixed <- matrix(FALSE, R + 1, C + 1)
    if (!is.null(like)) {
      init[R + 1, ]  <- c(col_lv %in% attr(like, "hidden"), isTRUE(attr(like, "total_hidden")))
      fixed[R + 1, ] <- c(col_lv %in% attr(like, "shown"), !init[R + 1, C + 1])
    }
    s_mat <- suppress_table(ext, init, fixed)
  }
  shown_s <- s_mat
  if (SHAREABLE) {
    # In a row or column whose total is below k, zeros are hidden too: otherwise they would show
    # which categories the small group falls into (e.g., a row that is zero everywhere but one cell).
    small_row <- ext[, C + 1] > 0 & ext[, C + 1] < SUPPRESS_N
    small_col <- ext[R + 1, ] > 0 & ext[R + 1, ] < SUPPRESS_N
    shown_s <- s_mat | (ext == 0 & (outer(small_row, rep(TRUE, C + 1)) | outer(rep(TRUE, R + 1), small_col)))
  }

  pct <- ext / ext[, C + 1]
  cell <- matrix(paste0(fmt_pct(pct, digits), " (", fmt_n(ext), ")"), nrow(ext))
  no_pct <- s_mat[, C + 1]                      # rows (including Total) whose total is hidden
  cell[no_pct, ] <- matrix(fmt_n(ext[no_pct, , drop = FALSE]), sum(no_pct))
  cell[shown_s] <- SUPPR
  cell[, C + 1] <- ifelse(s_mat[, C + 1], SUPPR, fmt_n(ext[, C + 1]))
  colnames(cell) <- c(col_lv, "N")
  out <- as_tibble(cell) |> mutate(!!row_label := c(row_lv, "Total"), .before = 1)
  attr(out, "hidden") <- union(attr(like, "hidden"), col_lv[s_mat[R + 1, seq_len(C)]])
  attr(out, "shown")  <- col_lv[!s_mat[R + 1, seq_len(C)]]
  attr(out, "total_hidden") <- s_mat[R + 1, C + 1]
  out
}

# Show a table and keep a copy for the CSV export at the end.
EXPORT <- list()
show_table <- function(tbl, id, caption = NULL) {
  EXPORT[[id]] <<- tbl
  kable(tbl, caption = caption, align = c("l", rep("r", ncol(tbl) - 1)))
}

# Join keys compared as trimmed, lower-case text, so a number stored as text in one file and as a
# number in the other, or a stray space or capital, does not stop a provider from matching.
join_key <- function(x) str_to_lower(str_squish(as.character(x)))
```

```{r}
#| label: model-helpers
# Copied verbatim from the 4.02 script; keep them in sync.
to_date <- function(x) {
  if (inherits(x, "Date")) return(x)
  if (inherits(x, "POSIXt")) return(as_date(x))
  as_date(parse_date_time(as.character(x),
                          orders = c("Ymd", "mdY", "Ymd HMS", "mdY HMS", "Ymd HM", "mdY HM"),
                          quiet = TRUE))
}

as_flag <- function(x) {
  if (is.logical(x)) return(x)
  x <- str_to_lower(str_trim(as.character(x)))
  case_when(
    x %in% c("1", "yes", "y", "true", "t", "positive") ~ TRUE,
    x %in% c("0", "no", "n", "false", "f", "negative") ~ FALSE,
    TRUE ~ NA
  )
}

# Build a model-ready factor: small substantive levels are combined, "Other (combined)" and
# "Not reported" are placed last, and the reference level is set (with a size check).
prep_factor <- function(x, ref = NULL, min_n = SUPPRESS_N, lump = TRUE,
                        order = c("freq", "given"), given_levels = NULL) {
  order <- match.arg(order)
  tail_levels <- c("Other (combined)", "Not reported")
  x <- as.character(x)
  x[is.na(x)] <- "Not reported"
  if (lump) {
    counts <- table(x)
    small <- setdiff(names(counts)[counts < min_n], tail_levels)
    if (length(small)) x[x %in% small] <- "Other (combined)"
  }
  f <- if (order == "freq") {
    fct_infreq(x)
  } else {
    factor(x, levels = union(intersect(given_levels, unique(x)), sort(unique(x))))
  }
  f <- fct_relevel(f, intersect(tail_levels, levels(f)), after = Inf)
  counts <- table(f)
  if (!is.null(ref) && ref %in% levels(f) && counts[[ref]] >= min_n) {
    f <- fct_relevel(f, ref)
  } else {
    substantive <- setdiff(names(counts)[counts >= min_n], tail_levels)
    if (length(substantive)) f <- fct_relevel(f, names(which.max(counts[substantive])))
  }
  f
}

coef_or <- function(m) {
  cf <- summary(m)$coefficients
  tibble(term = rownames(cf), estimate = cf[, 1], std.error = cf[, 2], p.value = cf[, ncol(cf)]) |>
    filter(term != "(Intercept)", !str_detect(term, "\\|")) |>
    mutate(or = exp(estimate),
           lcl = exp(estimate - qnorm(0.975) * std.error),
           ucl = exp(estimate + qnorm(0.975) * std.error))
}

fmt_p   <- function(p) case_when(is.na(p) ~ NA_character_, p < 0.001 ~ "<0.001", TRUE ~ sprintf("%.3f", p))
fmt_or  <- function(or, l, u) if_else(is.na(or), NA_character_, sprintf("%.2f (%.2f–%.2f)", or, l, u))
fmt_num <- function(x, digits = 2) formatC(as.numeric(x), format = "f", digits = digits, big.mark = ",")
```

```{r}
#| label: subgroup-helpers
# ---- Subgroup comparisons (shared by the 2.01/2.02 and 3.01 scripts; keep them in sync) ----
qa_flow <- tibble(step = character(), n = integer())
qa_add <- function(step, n) qa_flow <<- bind_rows(qa_flow, tibble(step = step, n = as.integer(n)))

# Demographic groups for the comparisons. Non-substantive responses become missing here and are
# shown as their own "Not reported" group by `prep_factor()`.
add_demographic_groups <- function(d) {
  d |>
    mutate(
      race_grp               = clean_category(code_to_label(code_num, RACE_CODEBOOK), unname(NR_CODE_LABELS)),
      ethnicity_grp          = clean_category(code_to_label(ethn_num, ETHN_CODEBOOK), unname(NR_CODE_LABELS)),
      gender_identity_grp    = clean_category(gender_identity, NR_GENDER_IDENTITY),
      sexual_orientation_grp = clean_category(sexual_orientation, NR_SEXUAL_ORIENTATION),
      insurance_grp          = clean_category(insurance_status, NR_INSURANCE),
      client_type_grp        = clean_category(client_type, NR_CLIENT_TYPE)
    )
}

# Outcome by group as a two-way table: the percentage and number of episodes with and without the
# outcome in each group. `outcome` is a logical column; rows where it is missing are left out.
tab_outcome_by <- function(d, group, outcome, label, like = NULL) {
  d <- filter(d, !is.na(.data[[outcome]]))
  tab_two_way(d[[group]], OUTCOME_LABELS[d[[outcome]] + 1L], label, OUTCOME_LABELS, digits = 1, like = like)
}

# One characteristic: outcome by group, a chi-square test, and unadjusted odds ratios from a logistic
# regression. Groups with fewer than SUPPRESS_N episodes are combined before the comparison (see
# `prep_factor()`). A group whose counts are suppressed gets no odds ratio, since the two together
# would narrow down the hidden counts. `like` is the overall outcome table (see `tab_two_way()`).
subgroup_section <- function(var, title, ref, d, outcome, like = NULL) {
  d <- d |> filter(!is.na(.data[[outcome]])) |> mutate(group = prep_factor(.data[[var]], ref))
  id <- str_remove(var, "_grp$")
  cat("\n\n## ", title, "\n\n", sep = "")
  counts <- tab_outcome_by(d, "group", outcome, title, like)
  show_table(counts, paste0(id, "_outcome"), caption = paste0("Episodes by outcome and ", str_to_lower(title))) |> print()
  if (nlevels(d$group) < 2) {
    cat("\n\nOnly one group has at least ", SUPPRESS_N, " episodes, so there is nothing to compare.\n\n", sep = "")
    return(invisible())
  }

  chi <- chisq.test(table(d$group, d[[outcome]]))
  tibble(Test = "Pearson chi-square", `Chi-square` = fmt_num(chi$statistic), df = as.character(chi$parameter),
         `p-value` = fmt_p(chi$p.value)) |>
    show_table(paste0(id, "_chisq")) |> print()

  fit <- glm(reformulate("group", outcome), data = d, family = binomial)
  hidden <- counts[[1]][rowSums(counts[-1] == SUPPR) > 0]
  tibble(group = levels(d$group)) |>
    left_join(mutate(coef_or(fit), group = str_remove(term, "^group")), by = "group") |>
    transmute(!!title := group,
              `Odds ratio (95% CI)` = case_when(group %in% hidden ~ SUPPR, row_number() == 1 ~ "Reference",
                                                TRUE ~ fmt_or(or, lcl, ucl)),
              `p-value` = if_else(group %in% hidden, SUPPR, fmt_p(p.value))) |>
    show_table(paste0(id, "_odds_ratios"),
               caption = paste0("Unadjusted odds of the outcome (", str_to_lower(OUTCOME_LABELS[2]), ") by ", str_to_lower(title))) |> print()
}
```

```{r}
#| label: load_data
all_data <- read_csv(cfg$path_demographic, show_col_types = FALSE, progress = FALSE)
combined_all <- read_csv(cfg$path_satisfaction, show_col_types = FALSE, progress = FALSE)
qa_add("Demographic file: rows read", nrow(all_data))
qa_add("Satisfaction file: rows read", nrow(combined_all))
```

```{r}
#| label: prep_data
# Each client's answer on their most recent satisfaction survey.
latest_lang <- combined_all |>
  mutate(date_completed = to_date(date_completed)) |>
  slice_max(date_completed, n = 1, with_ties = FALSE, by = client_system_id) |>
  select(client_system_id, lang)

data301 <- all_data |>
  filter(!is.na(location), !is.na(pre_score), !is.na(post_score)) |>
  left_join(latest_lang, by = "client_system_id", relationship = "many-to-one") |>
  add_demographic_groups() |>
  mutate(
    positive_outcome       = as_flag(positive_outcomes),
    sexual_orientation_grp = coalesce(unname(SO_MERGE[sexual_orientation_grp]), sexual_orientation_grp),
    lang_grp               = clean_category(lang)
  )

qa_add("Episodes with a location and both scores", nrow(data301))
qa_add("Unique clients among those episodes", n_distinct(data301$client_system_id))
qa_add("Episodes left out of every comparison because the outcome is missing or not yes/no", sum(is.na(data301$positive_outcome)))
qa_add("Episodes whose client has no satisfaction survey", sum(!data301$client_system_id %in% latest_lang$client_system_id))
```

## Positive outcomes overall

```{r}
#| label: outcome_overall
scored <- filter(data301, !is.na(positive_outcome))
overall <- tab_one_way(OUTCOME_LABELS[scored$positive_outcome + 1L], "Outcome", OUTCOME_LABELS, show_valid = FALSE)
show_table(overall, "outcome_overall", caption = "Episodes by outcome")
```

```{r}
#| label: comparisons
#| results: asis
pwalk(PREDICTORS, subgroup_section, d = data301, outcome = "positive_outcome", like = overall)
```

# Data quality checks

These counts are for review, not reporting.

```{r}
#| label: qa
#| results: asis
qa_flow |>
  mutate(n = fmt_n_qa(n)) |>
  rename(Step = step, N = n) |>
  show_table("qa_sample_flow", caption = "Sample flow") |>
  print()

# Raw values and the group each was compared in. Internal render only: these can be free text.
if (!SHAREABLE) {
  pmap_dfr(PREDICTORS, function(var, title, ref) {
    data301 |>
      filter(!is.na(.data[["positive_outcome"]])) |>
      mutate(Group = as.character(prep_factor(.data[[var]], ref))) |>
      count(Characteristic = title, Value = coalesce(.data[[var]], "(missing)"), Group, name = "Episodes")
  }) |>
    filter(Value != Group) |>
    mutate(Episodes = fmt_n(Episodes)) |>
    show_table("qa_combined_groups", caption = "Values that were combined into another group") |>
    print()
}
```

```{r}
#| label: export
export_long <- imap_dfr(EXPORT, function(tbl, id) {
  first <- names(tbl)[1]
  tbl |>
    mutate(across(everything(), as.character), row_order = row_number()) |>
    rename(row = all_of(first)) |>
    pivot_longer(-c(row, row_order), names_to = "column", values_to = "value") |>
    mutate(table = id, row_header = first, .before = 1)
}) |>
  mutate(render_mode = RUN_MODE, suppress_n = SUPPRESS_N, .before = 1)

export_path <- file.path(cfg$output_dir, paste0(FILE_TAG, "_tables_", RUN_MODE, ".csv"))
write_csv(export_long, export_path, na = "")
```
